Ryfon Al Graui, where have you been?

After the Eclipse Ball, Ryfon left on a mission he did not disclose the nature of, as he was bound by his word to Yorke. Yorke had summoned Ryfon on a mission passed down through the dwindling line of Eldermourne Druids for generations, since the birth of the first Abyssal dragons.
It was said that once, the metallic dragons were the guardians of our world, created by the gods to protect the mortals and safeguard them from the agents of chaos and elemental destruction, the chromatic dragons who were born of the Primordials (Konduell, Ordun, etc...). The metallic dragons fell slowly to time and the forces of evil, and the chromatics did the same. However, many of the chromatics who did not fall, who evaded the great doom of the dragons, were turned to Abyssal Dragons under the power of the Abyss, and that was the saving grace of the metallic.
All elder dragons are bound, one chromatic to one metallic, and thus, whose who became Abyssal were twisted and corrupted, but did not die, and neither did their twins. In the legend of the Eldermourne it was said that one day the world would be cracked open, and the Abyssal dragons would return, and so too would their metallic brethren, but they would need help. The druids were given the task by Tena, of reopening the gateway for the metallic guardians to return.

Ryfon brought a shard of the Oakenheart to the highest peak of the burning volcano known as the Wyrmspire, and reopened the gateway, when the time is right the metallic dragons will return. When Ryfon returned to the Oakenheart he was met with despair, Yorke and his followers had been attacked by demons, and most had not survived, including the old master druid.
They buried the dead, and Ryfon set the most powerful beasts of the forest, along with his druids on guard, to protect the Oakenheart as he traveled into the dark kingdom of Arkonia, to stop Catherine Rex from unleashing Thrydrax, the legendary keeper of the flame, king of the fire dragons.
In a note left by Yorke, Ryfon learned that a piece of the King's soul was imprisoned within Cain's Catacombs beneath Ironpetal, and if unleashed even a piece of the dragon's soul could destroy cities in a moment.
